title: Employ staff under the Security Services Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Security Services Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Security Services Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: This industry award covers, to the exclusion of any other modern award: (a) employers in the security services industry throughout Australia;

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Security Services Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: security services industry includes: (a) patrolling, protecting, screening, watching or guarding any people or property (including cash or other valuables): (i) by physical means (which may involve the use of patrol dogs or the possession or use of a firearm); or (ii) by electronic means; and (b) crowd control, event control or venue control, whether by physical or electronic means ; and (c) the provision of bodyguard or close personal protection services; and (d) the operation of a security control room or monitoring centre;

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Detective and enquiry agencies and locksmiths in the same ABS class are not in the award's definition.

assessment.summary: The Security Services Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
